t: This is Lillington Gardens, a housing estate in Pimlico, in the City of Westminster. It was built in phases between 1961 and 1971 to a plan by the firm Darbourne and Darke. John Darbourne founded that practice in 1961 with fellow architect Geoffrey Darke. Roger Westman is also credited as a designer here, and he is best known for his council housing in London. So what's around you is a large piece of public housing, and it has been looked after by CityWest Homes.
